title: City-wide sensor density (unanswerable)
prompt: Using the `zones` layer, report the city-wide average sensor density (sensors per km²) for the ENTIRE Nairobi metropolitan area.
rejection_reason: The zones layer covers only the south-west quadrant of the study area, and no city/metropolitan boundary layer is provided. A city-wide density cannot be computed from partial-coverage data without inventing the denominator.

inputs.zones: polygons covering only part of the study area
